Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 36
Reason for Mistake: When instructed to inspect the Wavy Gravy headstone’s photo and identify the headstone visible in the background (to extract the rhyme’s last line), WebSurfer simply clicked the same listing again and failed to analyze or report on the background headstone. This initial failure to follow the targeted inspection request led to repeated ineffective navigation (including later missteps like typing queries into a newsletter form) and ultimately to a guessed, unsupported final answer rather than the verified last line of the rhyme.
